caption:
Google has unveiled Gemini 4 Argon, its most powerful AI model to date, designed for multiple tasks, including cybersecurity. This model is touted to autonomously identify and patch critical software vulnerabilities. 📊

With Argon already in use by Google staff, it demonstrates significant advancements in coding and engineering capabilities. Should we expect more breakthroughs from Google in AI?

Sources: TechCrunch, Google Blog
